vadsrijk.karakter.modus.normaal.uitleg: The normal adventure. Fainting costs nothing: you wake up at your last campfire.
vadsrijk.karakter.modus.eenvads.uitleg: One life! Faint outside a town and your knight retires: a statue in the Rustende Ridders hall in Zwamzoet, then they play on as Normal (with a gold star). While alive: a gold heart by your name and 10% more xp.
vadsrijk.karakter.modus.knuffel.uitleg: Play the story at ease: monsters only do half their damage to you. You do get 10% less xp. A pink cloud by your name.
vadsrijk.karakter.scherm.makkelijker.tip: Lowers the game mode. It can never go back up!
vadsrijk.karakter.scherm.uitleg: Every knight has their own levels, gear, quests and Vadsmunten. Clothes, mounts, pets and the bank are shared.
vadsrijk.karakter.scherm.alleen_omlaag: Note: a mode can only be made easier later, never harder.
vadsrijk.karakter.niet.plek: You can only switch knights in a town or at a campfire.
vadsrijk.karakter.niet.arena: Not in the middle of a boss fight!
vadsrijk.karakter.niet.scene: Wait until the cutscene is over.
vadsrijk.karakter.fout.slot: That slot can't be used (taken or empty).
vadsrijk.karakter.fout.naam: Give your knight a name (letters and digits, max 16).
vadsrijk.karakter.fout.modus: A game mode can only get easier, not harder.
vadsrijk.karakter.pensioen.onder: Your knight gets a statue in the Rustende Ridders hall
vadsrijk.karakter.pensioen.iedereen: %s (%s) retires as a Rustende Ridder at level %s. A statue goes up in Zwamzoet!
vadsrijk.karakter.zaal.onder: They fainted once, and now rest in honour.
vadsrijk.karakter.optie: I want to play another knight
vadsrijk.karakter.tip.slots: You can have up to 3 knights! Talk to the Grootmeester in Zwamzoet or a campfire guard, or type /guhs vadsrijk karakter.
